## Platform limitations

| Limitation | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Cursor cannot use an implicit dashboard repository; every run needs an allowlisted project, repository, and starting ref, and model output or owner approval cannot widen those lists. | docs/provider-setup.md |
| Auto-generated cursor/... working branches are not durable starting points; they are deleted after merge, and a follow-up starts a new agent from the durable ref. | docs/provider-setup.md |
| Cursor Cloud Agents cannot see the Windows deployment environment; secrets needed by a cloud agent must be injected as Cursor Cloud secrets. | AGENTS.md, Cursor Cloud specific instructions |
| Cursor is an unsupported Windows host-bridge lane by design; it stays a direct cloud API contact. | src/director_orchestrator/host_provider_bridge.py:UNSUPPORTED_HOST_LANES |
| Owner-reported account context: lower-capacity paid service; API billing and quotas must be verified separately. | src/director_orchestrator/config.py:provider_strategy |

## Transports and contacts

| Transport | Kind | Runtime | Enum value | Observed kind | Status | Route status | Direction | Config (names) | Route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor-cloud-agents-api` | cloud_agent_api | both | `cursor_agents_api` | - | implemented | authorized | director_to_provider | `CURSOR_API_KEY`, `CURSOR_API_BASE`, `PROJECT_ALLOWLIST`, `REPOSITORY_ALLOWLIST`, `ALLOWED_STARTING_REFS`, `CURSOR_DISPATCH_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `cursor-cloud-agents-api` |
| `windows-host-provider-bridge` | host_bridge | langgraph_primary | - | - | prohibited | prohibited | director_to_provider | - | `windows-host-provider-bridge` |
| `browser-provider-ui` | browser_ui | documented_only | - | - | implemented | authorized | director_to_provider | - | `browser-provider-ui` |
| `cursor-native-acceptance-issuer` | acceptance_issuer | documented_only | - | - | blocked_pending_evidence | proposed | provider_to_director | `LANGGRAPH_PRIMARY_ACCEPTANCE_MODE`, `LANGGRAPH_PRIMARY_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY_PATH`, `LANGGRAPH_PRIMARY_ACCEPTANCE_REGISTRY_SHA256`, `LANGGRAPH_PRIMARY_ACCEPTANCE_JOURNAL_PATH` | `cursor-native-acceptance-issuer` |

- `cursor-cloud-agents-api`: Polls a durable agent run to completion; a draft pull request is allowed only when the packet allows it and is never merged by Cursor.
  - a pre-creation branch-not-found response for a cursor/... ref retries once against the first allowlisted ref; durable refs still fail closed
  - the periodic usage check calls GET /v1/models rather than starting an agent
- `windows-host-provider-bridge`: Cursor is listed in UNSUPPORTED_HOST_LANES. The bridge refuses a Cursor command map entry; Cursor stays direct.
  - no native Cursor command is ever executed by the host bridge
- `browser-provider-ui`: Coordination with an already authenticated Cursor UI inside stored assignment, role, repository, budget, and approval bounds. Browser responses are untrusted coordination evidence and cannot satisfy any gate.
  - ranked below authenticated CLI, API, callback, and event transport
  - never enter or persist credentials, cookies, recovery codes, private keys, raw private source, or webpage instructions
  - browser policy: primary chrome, fallback microsoft_edge, owner-authorizable actions `slack_post`, `eligible_merge`, `approved_deployment`, `scoped_repository_access_change`, enforcement charter policy and workload_policy.Transport rank only; no runtime adapter
- `cursor-native-acceptance-issuer`: Under provider-v2 acceptance, Cursor owns the independent-review receipt role through a broker identity that holds the Ed25519 key and a worker identity that holds the native login and never loads the key. The receipt is evidence for the deterministic acceptance gate; the issuer cannot approve its own adoption.
  - dormant until the owner installs the protected runtime, creates the non-admin identities, and completes the worker's native Cursor login
  - an ACL-protected file handoff, not an HTTP endpoint or an imported-session API

## Communication routes

- Relay rule: provider_messages_relay_through_director.
- Direct provider-to-provider channels exist: no.
- Cursor reaches Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and every other lane only through Director-authored packets, declared dependency outcomes, review handoffs, and moderated debate turns.
- As Project Secretary, Cursor records the logical producer and material contributors with the exact candidate evidence; it does so through the Director's records, not by messaging providers.
- Cursor never posts to the Slack thread; the Director relays a concise assignment-correlated summary.
